choices.assertion: tu-xa-quan-tri preselected in F05 and F06. Both modes submitted default and alternate selections; ADMIN link ID and program field matched the selected program.
F05 had no document control. F06 accepted blank email/files, rejected an executable on selection and accepted PDF metadata. Only name and phone were required.

Four receipts opened their matching queue, sample ID, recorded program and source route. Browser Back/Forward preserved the sample until explicit reset or reload. The /education#programs link opened the directory.
Both alternate program links were followed in the same browser document. Each form had its correct default; no stale receipt or input carried across slugs, Back or reload.

Instrumented File and FileReader methods, storage writes and fetch/XHR/non-GET transports remained unused while F05/F06 ran. A receipt existed in-session and disappeared after hard reload. All five localized direct documents declared noindex.
